blocks.title: When the Righteous are in Authority

texts.NIV84: A man who remains stiff-necked after many rebukes will suddenly be destroyed-without remedy.
texts.KJV: He, that being often reproved hardeneth his neck, shall suddenly be destroyed, and that without remedy.
texts.NKJV:
He who is often rebuked, and hardens his neck,
Will suddenly be destroyed, and that without remedy.
texts.DRB: The man that with a stiff neck despiseth him that reproveth him, shall suddenly be destroyed: and health shall not follow him.

texts.NIV84: When the righteous thrive, the people rejoice; when the wicked rule, the people groan.
texts.KJV: When the righteous are in authority, the people rejoice: but when the wicked beareth rule, the people mourn.
texts.NKJV:
When the righteous are in authority, the people rejoice;
But when a wicked man rules, the people groan.
texts.DRB: When just men increase, the people shall rejoice: when the wicked shall bear rule, the people shall mourn.

texts.NIV84: A man who loves wisdom brings joy to his father, but a companion of prostitutes squanders his wealth.
texts.KJV: Whoso loveth wisdom rejoiceth his father: but he that keepeth company with harlots spendeth his substance.
texts.NKJV:
Whoever loves wisdom makes his father rejoice,
But a companion of harlots wastes his wealth.
texts.DRB: A man that loveth wisdom, rejoiceth his father: but he that maintaineth bar lots, shall squander away his substance.

texts.NIV84: By justice a king gives a country stability, but one who is greedy for bribes tears it down.
texts.KJV: The king by judgment establisheth the land: but he that receiveth gifts overthroweth it.
texts.NKJV:
The king establishes the land by justice,
But he who receives bribes overthrows it.
texts.DRB: A just king setteth up the land: a covetous man shall destroy it.

texts.NIV84: Whoever flatters his neighbor is spreading a net for his feet.
texts.KJV: A man that flattereth his neighbour spreadeth a net for his feet.
texts.NKJV:
A man who flatters his neighbor
Spreads a net for his feet.
texts.DRB: A man that speaketh to his friend with flattering and dissembling words, spreadeth a net for his feet.

texts.NIV84: An evil man is snared by his own sin, but a righteous one can sing and be glad.
texts.KJV: In the transgression of an evil man there is a snare: but the righteous doth sing and rejoice.
texts.NKJV:
By transgression an evil man is snared,
But the righteous sings and rejoices.
texts.DRB: A snare shall entangle the wicked man when he sinneth: and the just shall praise and rejoice.

texts.NIV84: The righteous care about justice for the poor, but the wicked have no such concern.
texts.KJV: The righteous considereth the cause of the poor: but the wicked regardeth not to know it.
texts.NKJV:
The righteous considers the cause of the poor,
But the wicked does not understand such knowledge.
texts.DRB: The just taketh notice of the cause of the poor: the wicked is void of knowledge.

texts.NIV84: Mockers stir up a city, but wise men turn away anger.
texts.KJV: Scornful men bring a city into a snare: but wise men turn away wrath.
texts.NKJV:
Scoffers set a city aflame,
But wise men turn away wrath.
texts.DRB: Corrupt men bring a city to ruin: but wise men turn away wrath.

texts.NIV84: If a wise man goes to court with a fool, the fool rages and scoffs, and there is no peace.
texts.KJV: If a wise man contendeth with a foolish man, whether he rage or laugh, there is no rest.
texts.NKJV:
If a wise man contends with a foolish man,
Whether the fool rages or laughs, there is no peace.
texts.DRB: If a wise man contend with a fool, whether he be angry or laugh, he shall find no rest.

texts.NIV84: Bloodthirsty men hate a man of integrity and seek to kill the upright.
texts.KJV: The bloodthirsty hate the upright: but the just seek his soul.
texts.NKJV:
The bloodthirsty hate the blameless,
But the upright seek his well-being.
texts.DRB: Bloodthirsty men hate the upright: but just men seek his soul.

texts.NIV84: A fool gives full vent to his anger, but a wise man keeps himself under control.
texts.KJV: A fool uttereth all his mind: but a wise man keepeth it in till afterwards.
texts.NKJV:
A fool vents all his feelings,
But a wise man holds them back.
texts.DRB: A fool uttereth all his mind: a wise man deferreth, and keepeth it till afterwards.

blocks.title: The Lord Gives Light to the Eyes

texts.NIV84: If a ruler listens to lies, all his officials become wicked.
texts.KJV: If a ruler hearken to lies, all his servants are wicked.
texts.NKJV:
If a ruler pays attention to lies,
All his servants become wicked.
texts.DRB: A prince that gladly heareth lying words, hath all his servants wicked.

texts.NIV84: The poor man and the oppressor have this in common: The LORD gives sight to the eyes of both.
texts.KJV: The poor and the deceitful man meet together: the Lord lighteneth both their eyes.
texts.NKJV:
The poor man and the oppressor have this in common:
The Lord gives light to the eyes of both.
texts.DRB: The poor man and the creditor have met one another: the Lord is the enlightener of them both.

texts.NIV84: If a king judges the poor with fairness, his throne will always be secure.
texts.KJV: The king that faithfully judgeth the poor, his throne shall be established for ever.
texts.NKJV:
The king who judges the poor with truth,
His throne will be established forever.
texts.DRB: The king that judgeth the poor in truth, his throne shall be established for ever.

texts.NIV84: The rod of correction imparts wisdom, but a child left to himself disgraces his mother.
texts.KJV: The rod and reproof give wisdom: but a child left to himself bringeth his mother to shame.
texts.NKJV:
The rod and rebuke give wisdom,
But a child left to himself brings shame to his mother.
texts.DRB: The rod and reproof give wisdom: but the child that is left to his own will bringeth his mother to shame.

texts.NIV84: When the wicked thrive, so does sin, but the righteous will see their downfall.
texts.KJV: When the wicked are multiplied, transgression increaseth: but the righteous shall see their fall.
texts.NKJV:
When the wicked are multiplied, transgression increases;
But the righteous will see their fall.
texts.DRB: When the wicked are multiplied, crimes shall be multiplied: but the just shall see their downfall.

blocks.title: Happy is He Who Keeps the Law

texts.NIV84: Discipline your son, and he will give you peace; he will bring delight to your soul.
texts.KJV: Correct thy son, and he shall give thee rest; yea, he shall give delight unto thy soul.
texts.NKJV:
Correct your son, and he will give you rest;
Yes, he will give delight to your soul.
texts.DRB: Instruct thy son, and he shall refresh thee, and shall give delight to thy soul.

texts.NIV84: Where there is no revelation, the people cast off restraint; but blessed is he who keeps the law.
texts.KJV: Where there is no vision, the people perish: but he that keepeth the law, happy is he.
texts.NKJV:
Where there is no revelation, the people cast off restraint;
But happy is he who keeps the law.
texts.DRB: When prophecy shall fail, the people shall be scattered abroad: but he that keepeth the law is blessed.

texts.NIV84: A servant cannot be corrected by mere words; though he understands, he will not respond.
texts.KJV: A servant will not be corrected by words: for though he understand he will not answer.
texts.NKJV:
A servant will not be corrected by mere words;
For though he understands, he will not respond.
texts.DRB: A slave will not be corrected by words: because he understandeth what thou sayest, and will not answer.

texts.NIV84: Do you see a man who speaks in haste? There is more hope for a fool than for him.
texts.KJV: Seest thou a man that is hasty in his words? there is more hope of a fool than of him.
texts.NKJV:
Do you see a man hasty in his words?
There is more hope for a fool than for him.
texts.DRB: Hast thou seen a man hasty to speak? folly is rather to be looked for, than his amendment.

texts.NIV84: If a man pampers his servant from youth, he will bring grief in the end.
texts.KJV: He that delicately bringeth up his servant from a child shall have him become his son at the length.
texts.NKJV:
He who pampers his servant from childhood
Will have him as a son in the end.
texts.DRB: He that nourisheth his servant delicately from his childhood, afterwards shall find him stubborn.

blocks.title: Justice for Man Comes From the Lord

texts.NIV84: An angry man stirs up dissension, and a hot-tempered one commits many sins.
texts.KJV: An angry man stirreth up strife, and a furious man aboundeth in transgression.
texts.NKJV:
An angry man stirs up strife,
And a furious man abounds in transgression.
texts.DRB: A passionate man provoketh quarrels: and he that is easily stirred up to wrath, shall be more prone to sin.

texts.NIV84: A man's pride brings him low, but a man of lowly spirit gains honor.
texts.KJV: A man's pride shall bring him low: but honour shall uphold the humble in spirit.
texts.NKJV:
A man’s pride will bring him low,
But the humble in spirit will retain honor.
texts.DRB: Humiliation followeth the proud: and glory shall uphold the humble of spirit.

texts.NIV84: The accomplice of a thief is his own enemy; he is put under oath and dare not testify.
texts.KJV: Whoso is partner with a thief hateth his own soul: he heareth cursing, and bewrayeth it not.
texts.NKJV:
Whoever is a partner with a thief hates his own life;
He swears to tell the truth, but reveals nothing.
texts.DRB: He that is partaker with a thief, hateth his own soul: he heareth one putting him to his oath, and discovereth not.

texts.NIV84: Fear of man will prove to be a snare, but whoever trusts in the LORD is kept safe.
texts.KJV: The fear of man bringeth a snare: but whoso putteth his trust in the Lord shall be safe.
texts.NKJV:
The fear of man brings a snare,
But whoever trusts in the Lord shall be safe.
texts.DRB: He that feareth man, shall quickly fall: he that trusteth in the Lord, shall be set on high.

texts.NIV84: Many seek an audience with a ruler, but it is from the LORD that man gets justice.
texts.KJV: Many seek the ruler's favour; but every man's judgment cometh from the Lord.
texts.NKJV:
Many seek the ruler’s favor,
But justice for man comes from the Lord.
texts.DRB: Many seek the face of the prince: but the judgment of every one cometh forth from the Lord.

texts.NIV84: The righteous detest the dishonest; the wicked detest the upright.
texts.KJV: An unjust man is an abomination to the just: and he that is upright in the way is abomination to the wicked.
texts.NKJV:
An unjust man is an abomination to the righteous,
And he who is upright in the way is an abomination to the wicked.
texts.DRB: The just abhor the wicked man: and the wicked loathe them that are in the right way. The son that keepeth the word, shall be free from destruction.
